content.thinking:
Hmm! `check("peer-empty-authority", ...)` — I built CTX2 but never passed it to `run`! `run(jobs)` uses the global CTX. So the test used CTX where peer "p" has authority ["studio.test"] → accept ✓ correct. My test bug: I need to pass ctx2 to run.

Let me fix by making run accept a ctx parameter.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
p=open('tmp/t6.py').read()
p=p.replace('''def run(jobs):
    batch = dict(CTX); batch["jobs"] = jobs''','''def run(jobs, ctx=None):
    batch = dict(ctx or CTX); batch["jobs"] = jobs''')
p=p.replace('''check("peer-empty-authority", [{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "peer", "name": "p"},
                                "trusted_out": True, "raw": GOOD}], [rej("identity")])''',
'''check("peer-empty-authority", run([{"gateway": "g", "ingress": {"kind": "peer", "name": "p"},
                                   "trusted_out": True, "raw": GOOD}], CTX2), [rej("identity")])''')
open('tmp/t6.py','w').write(p)
EOF
python3 tmp/t6.py
